input.summary: Logged in as admin, opened User Management (/admin/users), and filtered the users table by account number 1234567890 via the search input, which narrowed the list to exactly one row (All Users (1)) for that member. The member's row is visible with the BALANCE column populated; the actual amount is masked in the recording screenshot by this system's pre-send redaction, so the balance is returned via a DOM selector that resolves to the live value at replay time rather than a literal copied from this run. Declared checkpoint (selector_visible, `.users-card :text("1234567890")`): the account-number cell for this member is rendered inside the results card — structural and scoped so it cannot be satisfied by the search box merely echoing the typed number, and it depends only on the member identifier (the capability's input), not on the name, email, balance or created date, all of which can change between runs. Declared output account_balance (dom_selector, `.users-card :text-matches("^[$][0-9,]+([.][0-9]{2})?$")`): points at the balance cell by position and currency format inside the results card, so it re-reads whatever the balance is on each replay. Cell-level class names were not available — the DOM excerpt is truncated at a fixed 4000 chars right at the row markup — so both selectors deliberately rely only on containers confirmed verbatim in the DOM. No popup, banner or interstitial appeared during this run, so nothing was declared recoverable, and no non-success state (e.g. no matching member) was observed, so no business outcome was declared.
